name: cutover-plan
title: Cutover plan
for_each: select id,code from runbooks order by code

sections.title: Tasks and rollback instructions
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,stream,duration_minutes,critical,rollback from tasks where runbook_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Predecessors
sections.sql: select t.code as task,p.code as predecessor from dependencies d join tasks t on t.id=d.task_id join tasks p on p.id=d.predecessor_id where d.runbook_id=$1 order by t.code

name: decision-record
title: Go or no-go decision record
for_each: select id,code from runbooks order by code

sections.title: Human decisions
sections.sql: select revision,choice,actor,evidence,created_at from decisions where runbook_id=$1 order by seq desc

sections.title: Rehearsals and live runs
sections.sql: select code,revision,mode,status,actor,started_at,ended_at from runs where runbook_id=$1 order by seq desc

name: run-evidence
title: Run evidence and handover
for_each: select id,code from runs order by code

sections.title: Task results
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,status,evidence,actor,completed_at from run_tasks where run_id=$1 order by code
